observations.why: Directive issued in present attention commands erasure of a named decision — an irrealis act of removal targeting an abstract category (the decision), not a concrete event.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration

observations.why: Present-tense directive commanding removal of knowledge about a specific, named migration — irrealis because it prescribes a desired action not yet settled; concrete because it names a particular artifact.
